Just Decide Already

For the moment when you've researched something so much that you have somehow become less capable of choosing.

What it does

It compares your options, exposes which criteria actually matter, identifies false distinctions and forces a decision framework.

When to use it

  • You've got a comparison spreadsheet and still no answer.
  • You keep reopening a decision you already made.

What to give it

  • The options.
  • What you've learned so far. Messy is fine.
  • What happens if you don't decide.

What you get back

  • The two or three criteria that actually matter.
  • Which differences between the options aren't real.
  • A decision framework that ends in a choice.

How to use this in Claude

  1. Download the .zip. Don’t unzip it.
  2. In the Claude app, open Settings and find Skills.
  3. Upload the .zip and switch it on.
  4. Start a new chat and just ask for the thing. Claude picks up the Skill on its own.

Works on any Claude plan that has Skills turned on.
